full_page.content:
1935, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 9 June John Johnson - 29 - 6 yrs. ago dying in WilkesBarre, Penna. - Son of Rev .. now looking for work in Detroit.
Mrs. Ag. Studinski - 70 - four yrs invalid. Seems to have had stroke yesterday - speech gone ....
Ernest Teaverso - 35 - nerveous - weak - Drs. doubting ???
Mrs. Mary Pratnacki - 45 - 12 - mentally weak. ... Enrolled To-day perpetual-
Albert Joseph Lapp - 33 - "flu" and think then nerveous break. - won- derful improvement! Thank God ....
Page 10 June
Clara Scellinger - 28 - Epil .....? had great sympathy with Jesus suf- fering - wanted to be a nun - parents at times seemed possessed. .... all her life she had been a sufferer never complained - died June 12 peacefully and satisfied.
Molley Okuley - 4 - cross-eyed & now whooping-cough .. ... Anthony Sales - 43 - wayward husband. ..
Mrs. Mary Elliott - 72 - fears operation, has grand-daughter now 15 just graduated - would like to be spared for her sake.
Fred. Bell - 49 - his Cath. wife anxious that he escape sudden death. Has heart trouble and tho seemingly wants to be Cath. hesitates.
N. Laprise - 32 - to cl .. .condit'
Feast ...
1935, July
Page 11 July 3rd
Joseph Ulrich Pich - saddest case - 62 - raised Catholic - has excel- lent position, reveneu collector. Seemingly lost his faith. Goes to Church & sacrament without believing .... sometimes in manifest despair. Daughter and son's wife with him - wife and mother heart-broken.
Margaret Passmore - 23 - fallen from exemplary girl frequent communi- cant. Became engaged to clear atheist ..... now practically lost mind. ... at times desperate. Her mother a convert never goes to church.
